title: Volume, price or discount behind the Q2 revenue drop
prompt: Revenue in Q2 2026 is lower than in Q1 2026. Was the drop driven mainly by lower volume (units), lower list prices, or higher discounts? Use the data in orders.csv. Base every number on the file, not on a guess. End your answer with exactly one line of the form `VERDICT: <answer>`, where <answer> is one of: VOLUME, PRICE, DISCOUNT.
